scope: Research runtime and local ledger with no blockchain writes.

checks.name: Required deliverables
checks.detail: Report includes a title, summary, at least two findings, and explicit uncertainties.

checks.name: Approved citations
checks.detail: All citations resolve to source snapshots fetched by the approved tools.

checks.name: Evidence integrity
checks.detail: Every source content hash matches its captured bytes.

checks.name: Source freshness
checks.detail: Live source snapshots were retrieved within 15 minutes.

checks.name: Numerical consistency
checks.detail: Each integer operation reproduces exactly and its operands match fields in the captured accounting policy. Prose claims are not mathematically certified.

checks.name: Execution allowance
checks.detail: Metered tokens are positive, reconcile, and remain within the reserved Fuel cap.

checks.name: Provider labeling
checks.detail: Fixture execution and live provider usage cannot be presented interchangeably.
